title: Maria Learns to Cook
text:
Maria wants to make dinner for her family. She looks at a book and reads the steps. She cuts the tomatoes and mixes them with onions. Then she puts the pot on the stove and waits.

Her brother Luis comes into the kitchen. He opens the fridge and takes out some cheese. Maria smiles and asks him to help her wash the plates. Luis jumps up and says, 'Yes, I can help!'

questions.text: What does Luis take out of the fridge?
Why does Maria read the steps in the book?
options: She wants to know how to cook dinner
She wants to play a game
She is looking for a friend

questions.text: How does Luis probably feel about helping Maria?

vocabulary.definition: uses a knife to divide something into pieces
the room where food is prepared
the main meal of the day, often in the evening
to do something with someone so they can finish a task

paragraph_translations: Maria quiere preparar la cena para su familia. Mira un libro y lee los pasos. Corta los tomates y los mezcla con cebollas. Después pone la olla en la estufa y espera.
Su hermano Luis entra en la cocina. Abre la nevera y saca un poco de queso. Maria sonríe y le pide que le ayude a lavar los platos. Luis salta y dice: '¡Sí, puedo ayudar!'
